description: Bring your brand intelligence into every AI workflow. The Dash Social plugin connects your brand, performance, competitive, and community intelligence directly to ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying data between platforms, ChatGPT gets the real-time brand context it needs to deliver more relevant, on-brand recommendations and actions. That means your team can keep working with the AI tools they use today, while Dash Social provides the trusted brand intelligence needed to drive better results.

defaultPrompt: Show me this month’s social media performance across all our brands and summarize the key takeaways for leadership.
Surface what my audience is saying. Give me a brand health overview with top keywords, sentiment, and Community metrics.
Show me what’s scheduled for the next 7 days and recommend changes to optimize posting times based on historical performance.
